title: boronia tetrandra var. pilosa
intro: Boronia tetrandra var. pilosa, commonly known as Pink Boronia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rutaceae, native to Australia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe skin irritations, wounds, and other health issues. The therapeutic actions of Boronia tetrandra var. pilosa include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic actions, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
